description: The plot illustrates the performance of three different methods with respect to temperature. The x-axis is labeled "Temperature" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with no units specified and tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)" and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks ranging from 62.5 to 80.0 at intervals of 2.5. The "On-policy RL" method is represented by a solid orange line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it starts at approximately 63.7 at a temperature of 0.1, rises to about 70.0 at 0.2, reaches a steady value of roughly 71.7 at 0.5 and 0.6, drops to 67.3 at 0.7, peaks at approximately 75.2 at 0.8, and ends at roughly 73.5 at 1.0. The "LUFFY" method is shown as a solid dark red line with star markers, beginning at approximately 76.1 at 0.1, rising to about 78.8 at 0.2, remaining steady at 76.1 for 0.3 and 0.4 and at 77.0 for 0.5 and 0.6, before reaching its highest values of approximately 80.5 at both 0.8 and 1.0. The "SFT" method is depicted by a solid dark teal line with downward-pointing triangle markers, starting at its highest point of approximately 76.2 at 0.1, declining to a low of roughly 70.0 at 0.5, sharply increasing to about 76.1 at 0.6, and then fluctuating before ending at approximately 74.3 at a temperature of 1.0.
